ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Svchost Parent Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects an uncommon svchost parent process

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Mrt\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ngen\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rpcnet\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\TiWorker\\\.exe$")) OR parent_process_path = "None" OR (parent_process_path = "\-" OR parent_process_path = ""))
